description: This is a test class for the ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPI, an API related to employee review supervision within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It contains unit tests for various endpoints of the API, mainly testing the 'getAll' method with data providers and asserting exceptions for other methods that are not implemented.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPITest
classes.description: This class performs unit testing on the ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPI endpoints, validating their behavior, especially focusing on the 'getAll' method with multiple data cases, and ensuring proper exceptions are thrown for unimplemented methods.
